name: Nahor
bio: Nahor is the son of Terah and brother of Abram, who married his niece Milcah, daughter of Haran (Genesis 11:26-29). Scripture records very little about Nahor himself, yet his family line plays an important role later on — in Isaac's marriage to Rebekah (Genesis 24) and Jacob's time with Laban (Genesis 29) — since Rebekah and Laban are both his descendants, bringing his name back repeatedly through the family's later marriage stories.
